cases.title: Dig through a floor boulder over a spiked pit
cases.sourceTrace: C dighole settles a boulder into the spiked pit at step271 and deletes it. JavaScript dig.js calls existing delobj without the floor extraction hook; invent.js preflightObjectExtraction refuses extractExternalObject for BOULDER475 before the next screen. The existing helper is implemented; this production caller omits its floor adapter.
